macros.name: countvalues
macros.doc: \countvalues {⟨comma separated list⟩} expands to the number of values in the list.

macros.name: interitem
macros.doc: Just like AMS \intertext in math formulæ, \interitem allows to put some non intented text inside a list environment.

macros.name: listofsetup
macros.doc: This command is provided to setup the parameters of user-defined lists created with tocloft’s \newlistof and printed with \listofX (where X is the name given to the list).

macros.name: pagesetup

macros.name: pgfkeysmeaning
macros.doc: The command \pgfkeysmeaning is provided (with \providecommand): it expands to the meaning of the given pgfkey.

macros.name: removefrom
macros.doc: \removefrom removes the first occurence of {⟨code⟩} from a ⟨hook⟩.

macros.name: repeatcell
macros.doc: \repeatcell: to create `dynamic' tabulars, possibly with formulas computation: \numexpr, \pgfmathparse or \FPeval formulas can be plugged in the tabular or array, with the possibility to transpose.

macros.doc: \tocsetup: interface for package tocloft to fine tune the aspect of the table of contents, list of figures / of tables.

macros.name: usetikz
macros.doc: \usetikz is a facility provided to load pgf, tikz, pgf-modules, and tikz-libraries, without the need to know if you must use \usepackage or \usepgfmodule or \usetikzlibrary.
